sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sysauto_script"><sysauto_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>false</advanced><business_calendar/><condition/><conditional>false</conditional><entered_run_end/><entered_run_start/><entered_time/><max_drift/><name>ITAM Toolkit: drift scan and DQ snapshot</name><offset/><offset_type>0</offset_type><repeat_every/><run_as display_value="System Administrator">6816f79cc0a8016401c5a33be04be441</run_as><run_as_tz/><run_dayofmonth>1</run_dayofmonth><run_dayofweek/><run_daysofweek/><run_end/><run_month/><run_period/><run_start>2026-11-11 11:43:43</run_start><run_time>1970-01-01 02:00:00</run_time><run_type>daily</run_type><run_weekinmonth/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scheduled job «ITAM Toolkit: drift scan and DQ snapshot», daily.
 * Per active scorecard: refresh the drift findings of its company, then store a snapshot.
 */
(function () {
    const card = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('dq_scorecard'));
    card.addActiveQuery();
    card.query();
    while (card.next()) {
        const drift = new AssetCiDrift().scan(card.getValue('company'));
        const snapshot = new DqScorecard().run(card.getUniqueValue(), 'scheduled');
        gs.info('ITAM Toolkit nightly ' + card.getValue('name') + ': ' + JSON.stringify({drift: drift, snapshot: {
            success: snapshot.success, status_code: snapshot.status_code, message: snapshot.message}}));
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sysauto_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>820323ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131c4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM Toolkit: drift scan and DQ snapshot</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysauto_script_820323ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131c4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:43</sys_updated_on><time_zone/><upgrade_safe>false</upgrade_safe></sysauto_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_41f22facc3ac171015b012d4e4013195
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitResult</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Output contract {success, status_code, message, data} of every building block</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitResult</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitResult: the output contract of every ITAM Toolkit building block.
 *
 * Every public method of the toolkit returns
 *     { success: boolean, status_code: number, message: string, data?: object }
 * The REST API passes the same object through, so callers (flows, scripts,
 * Python checks) never have to parse log lines.
 *
 * status_code follows HTTP semantics:
 *   200 done, 201 created, 204 nothing to do, 208 already done (idempotent repeat),
 *   400 invalid input, 403 missing role, 404 not found, 409 conflict with the current state,
 *   422 configuration invalid (for example a DQ rule with an unknown field), 500 unexpected error.
 */
var ItamKitResult = Class.create();

ItamKitResult.make = function (success, statusCode, message, data) {
    const result = {success: success, status_code: statusCode, message: String(message)};
    if (data !== undefined) result.data = data;
    return result;
};

ItamKitResult.ok = function (statusCode, message, data) {
    return ItamKitResult.make(true, statusCode, message, data);
};

ItamKitResult.fail = function (statusCode, message, data) {
    return ItamKitResult.make(false, statusCode, message, data);
};

ItamKitResult.fromError = function (err, context) {
    const text = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err);
    gs.error('ITAM Toolkit ' + context + ': ' + text);
    return ItamKitResult.fail(500, context + ' failed: ' + text);
};

ItamKitResult.prototype = {
    type: 'ItamKitResult'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>41f22facc3ac171015b012d4e4013195</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ItamKitResult</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_41f22facc3ac171015b012d4e4013195</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:23</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_a1f22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131de
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitAudit</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Toolkit audit log for changes to records the toolkit does not own</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitAudit</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitAudit: one row per change the toolkit makes to a record it does not own
 * (asset status after a return, CI or asset status after a drift fix).
 * Complements sys_audit: the row says why the toolkit changed the value and which
 * side was leading, not only that it changed.
 */
var ItamKitAudit = Class.create();

/**
 * entry: {module, action, table, id, display, field, oldValue, newValue, leadingSide, finding, note}
 * Returns the sys_id of the audit row.
 */
ItamKitAudit.log = function (entry) {
    const row = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('audit_log'));
    row.initialize();
    row.setValue('module', entry.module || '');
    row.setValue('action', entry.action || '');
    row.setValue('target_table', entry.table || '');
    row.setValue('target_id', entry.id || '');
    row.setValue('target_display', entry.display || '');
    row.setValue('field', entry.field || '');
    row.setValue('old_value', entry.oldValue === undefined ? '' : String(entry.oldValue));
    row.setValue('new_value', entry.newValue === undefined ? '' : String(entry.newValue));
    row.setValue('leading_side', entry.leadingSide || '');
    if (entry.finding) row.setValue('finding', entry.finding);
    row.setValue('note', entry.note || '');
    return row.insert();
};

/** Logs every field whose value differs between two {field: value} snapshots. */
ItamKitAudit.logChanges = function (base, before, after) {
    let rows = 0;
    Object.keys(after).forEach(function (field) {
        if (String(before[field] || '') === String(after[field] || '')) return;
        ItamKitAudit.log(Object.assign({}, base, {field: field, oldValue: before[field], newValue: after[field]}));
        rows++;
    });
    return rows;
};

ItamKitAudit.prototype = {
    type: 'ItamKitAudit'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>a1f22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131de</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ItamKitAudit</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a1f22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131de</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:25</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>health</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/** GET /health: app version and scope; role user. */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    ItamKitRest.handle(request, response, 'user', function () {
        const app = new GlideRecord('sys_scope');
        app.get('scope', ItamKitConfig.scope());
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, 'ITAM Toolkit ' + app.getValue('version') + ' is running', {
            app: app.getValue('name'), version: app.getValue('version'), scope_suffix: 'itamkit'
        });
    });
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_371499_itamkit/toolkit/health</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/health</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>af0323ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013116</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>health</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_af0323ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013116</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:50</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ITAM Toolkit">4f0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131a4</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_bdf26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013104
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.LeaverAssetResolver</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Module 1: leaver asset return, idempotent</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LeaverAssetResolver</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * LeaverAssetResolver: asset return compliance for leavers on ServiceNow Core (no HAM Pro).
 *
 * One leaver case (<scope>_leaver_case, extends task) per leaver, one asset_task per
 * hardware asset that is still assigned to the leaver. Idempotent: calling it again
 * for the same leaver creates nothing new and answers 208.
 *
 * Entry points (all return the ItamKitResult contract {success, status_code, message, data}):
 *   resolve(userId, source, options)  open or reuse the case, create the missing return tasks
 *   syncTasks(caseGr)                 create missing return tasks, refresh counters, close when done
 *   completeReturn(taskId, outcome)   record one return: asset end state, task closed, case counters
 *   prepareReportedCase(current, producer)  record producer «Austritt melden» (HR)
 *   sweep(options)                    nightly: deactivations that bypassed the trigger, open cases, reminders
 *   sendDueReminders(caseQuery)       reminders on day 3, 7, 14 after the last working day (last = escalation)
 *   kpis(query)                       return rate and cycle time of closed cases (ISO 27001 A.5.11 evidence)
 */
var LeaverAssetResolver = Class.create();

/** End states of a return, checked against the OOTB choices of alm_asset.install_status/substatus. */
LeaverAssetResolver.OUTCOMES = {
    in_stock: {state: '6', substatus: 'available', returned: true, label: 'Returned: in stock'},
    pending_repair: {state: '6', substatus: 'pending_repair', returned: true, label: 'Returned: pending repair'},
    pending_disposal: {state: '6', substatus: 'pending_disposal', returned: true, label: 'Returned: pending disposal'},
    missing_lost: {state: '8', substatus: 'lost', returned: false, label: 'Missing: lost'}
};

LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_COMPLETE = '3';
LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE = '4';
LeaverAssetResolver.PRIORITY_HIGH = '2';

/** Form buttons on asset_task call this with their outcome. */
LeaverAssetResolver.uiComplete = function (current, outcome) {
    const result = new LeaverAssetResolver().completeReturn(current.getUniqueValue(), outcome);
    if (result.success) {
        gs.addInfoMessage(result.message);
    } else {
        gs.addErrorMessage(result.message);
    }
    return result;
};

LeaverAssetResolver.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.caseTable = ItamKitConfig.table('leaver_case');
        this.outcomeField = ItamKitConfig.outcomeField();
        this.assetQuery = ItamKitConfig.prop('leaver.asset_query', 'install_statusNOT IN6,7,8');
        this.assignmentGroup = ItamKitConfig.prop('leaver.assignment_group', '');
        this.reminderDays = String(ItamKitConfig.prop('leaver.reminder_days', '3,7,14')).split(',')
            .map(function (d) { return parseInt(d, 10); })
            .filter(function (d) { return d > 0; })
            .sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    },

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- triggers

    /**
     * Opens (or reuses) the leaver case of a user and creates one return task per assigned asset.
     * source: record_producer | user_deactivated | nightly_sweep | manual
     * options: {lastWorkingDay: 'yyyy-MM-dd', hrContact: sys_id, privateEmail: string}
     */
    resolve: function (userId, source, options) {
        options = options || {};
        try {
            const invalid = this._invalidAssetQuery();
            if (invalid) return invalid;
            const user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
            if (!userId || !user.get(userId)) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'User not found: ' + userId);
            const name = user.getDisplayValue();

            let leaverCase = this.findOpenCase(userId);
            let created = false;
            if (!leaverCase) {
                if (!this._assignedAssets(userId).length) {
                    return ItamKitResult.ok(204, name + ' has no assigned hardware; no case opened', {user: userId});
                }
                leaverCase = this._createCase(user, source, options);
                created = true;
            } else if (options.lastWorkingDay && leaverCase.getValue('last_working_day') !== options.lastWorkingDay) {
                this._setLastWorkingDay(leaverCase, options.lastWorkingDay, false);
                leaverCase.update();
            }

            const sync = this.syncTasks(leaverCase);
            if (!sync.success) return sync;
            const data = Object.assign({case_id: leaverCase.getUniqueValue(), case_number: leaverCase.getValue('number')}, sync.data);
            if (created) {
                return ItamKitResult.ok(201, data.case_number + ' opened for ' + name + ' with ' + data.tasks_total + ' return task(s)', data);
            }
            if (data.tasks_created) {
                return ItamKitResult.ok(200, data.case_number + ': ' + data.tasks_created + ' return task(s) added for ' + name, data);
            }
            return ItamKitResult.ok(208, data.case_number + ' already covers all ' + data.tasks_total + ' asset(s) of ' + name, data);
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'LeaverAssetResolver.resolve');
        }
    },

    /**
     * Record producer «Austritt melden»: fills the new case from the variables.
     * Aborts the insert when the leaver already has an open case and updates that case instead.
     */
    prepareReportedCase: function (current, producer) {
        const userId = String(producer.leaver || '');
        const lastWorkingDay = String(producer.last_working_day || '');
        const privateEmail = String(producer.private_email || '');
        const user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (!userId || !user.get(userId)) {
            current.setAbortAction(true);
            return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Please select the leaver.');
        }
        const open = this.findOpenCase(userId);
        if (open) {
            this._setLastWorkingDay(open, lastWorkingDay, false);
            if (privateEmail) open.setValue('private_email', privateEmail);
            if (!open.getValue('hr_contact')) open.setValue('hr_contact', gs.getUserID());
            open.work_notes = 'HR reported the leaver again; last working day set to ' + lastWorkingDay + '.';
            open.update();
            current.setAbortAction(true);
            return ItamKitResult.ok(208, open.getValue('number') + ' is already open for ' + user.getDisplayValue() +
                '; last working day updated.', {case_id: open.getUniqueValue(), case_number: open.getValue('number')});
        }
        this._fillCase(current, user, 'record_producer', {
            lastWorkingDay: lastWorkingDay,
            hrContact: gs.getUserID(),
            privateEmail: privateEmail
        });
        return ItamKitResult.ok(201, 'Leaver case for ' + user.getDisplayValue() + ' created.');
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- return tasks

    /** Creates the missing return tasks of a case, refreshes the counters and closes the case when done. */
    syncTasks: function (leaverCase) {
        try {
            const invalid = this._invalidAssetQuery();
            if (invalid) return invalid;
            const caseId = leaverCase.getUniqueValue();
            const userId = leaverCase.getValue('leaver');
            const covered = {};
            const tasks = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
            tasks.addQuery('parent', caseId);
            tasks.query();
            while (tasks.next()) covered[tasks.getValue('asset')] = true;

            let created = 0;
            const leaverName = leaverCase.leaver.getDisplayValue();
            this._assignedAssets(userId).forEach(function (asset) {
                if (covered[asset.sys_id]) return;
                const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
                task.initialize();
                task.setValue('parent', caseId);
                task.setValue('asset', asset.sys_id);
                task.setValue('requested_for', userId);
                task.setValue('model', asset.model);
                task.setValue('company', leaverCase.getValue('company'));
                task.setValue('task_name', 'Leaver asset return');
                task.setValue('short_description', 'Return ' + asset.display + ' (leaver ' + leaverName + ')');
                task.setValue('due_date', leaverCase.getValue('due_date'));
                if (leaverCase.getValue('assignment_group')) task.setValue('assignment_group', leaverCase.getValue('assignment_group'));
                task.insert();
                created++;
            });

            const counters = this._updateCounters(caseId);
            return ItamKitResult.ok(created ? 201 : 208, created + ' return task(s) created', Object.assign({tasks_created: created}, counters));
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'LeaverAssetResolver.syncTasks');
        }
    },

    /**
     * Records the outcome of one return task.
     * outcome: in_stock | pending_repair | pending_disposal | missing_lost
     */
    completeReturn: function (taskId, outcome) {
        try {
            const spec = LeaverAssetResolver.OUTCOMES[outcome];
            if (!spec) {
                return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Unknown outcome "' + outcome + '"; use one of ' +
                    Object.keys(LeaverAssetResolver.OUTCOMES).join(', '));
            }
            const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
            if (!taskId || !task.get(taskId)) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Return task not found: ' + taskId);
            if (!this.isLeaverTask(task)) return ItamKitResult.fail(409, task.getValue('number') + ' is not a leaver return task');
            if (!ItamKitConfig.isTrue(task.active)) {
                const recorded = task.getValue(this.outcomeField);
                if (recorded === outcome) {
                    return ItamKitResult.ok(208, task.getValue('number') + ' is already closed as ' + spec.label);
                }
                return ItamKitResult.fail(409, task.getValue('number') + ' is already closed with outcome "' + recorded + '"');
            }
            const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
            if (!asset.get(task.getValue('asset'))) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, task.getValue('number') + ' has no hardware asset');

            const before = this._assetState(asset);
            asset.setValue('install_status', spec.state);
            asset.setValue('substatus', spec.substatus);
            if (spec.returned) {
                asset.setValue('assigned_to', '');
                if (task.getValue('stockroom')) asset.setValue('stockroom', task.getValue('stockroom'));
            }
            asset.update();
            asset.get(asset.getUniqueValue());
            const after = this._assetState(asset);
            ItamKitAudit.logChanges({
                module: 'leaver', action: 'return_' + outcome, table: 'alm_hardware',
                id: asset.getUniqueValue(), display: asset.getDisplayValue(),
                note: task.getValue('number') + ' (' + task.parent.getDisplayValue() + ')'
            }, before, after);

            task.setValue(this.outcomeField, outcome);
            task.setValue('state', spec.returned ? LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_COMPLETE : LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE);
            task.work_notes = spec.label + '. Asset ' + asset.getDisplayValue() + ': ' + asset.install_status.getDisplayValue() +
                (asset.getValue('substatus') ? ' / ' + asset.substatus.getDisplayValue() : '') + '.';
            task.update();

            const counters = this._updateCounters(task.getValue('parent'));
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, task.getValue('number') + ': ' + spec.label + '; ' + asset.getDisplayValue() + ' is now ' +
                asset.install_status.getDisplayValue() + (asset.getValue('substatus') ? ' / ' + asset.substatus.getDisplayValue() : ''),
                Object.assign({task: task.getValue('number'), asset: asset.getDisplayValue(), outcome: outcome}, counters));
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'LeaverAssetResolver.completeReturn');
        }
    },

    isLeaverTask: function (task) {
        return !task.parent.nil() && task.parent.sys_class_name.toString() === this.caseTable;
    },

    findOpenCase: function (userId) {
        const leaverCase = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
        leaverCase.addQuery('leaver', userId);
        leaverCase.addActiveQuery();
        leaverCase.orderBy('opened_at');
        leaverCase.setLimit(1);
        leaverCase.query();
        return leaverCase.next() ? leaverCase : null;
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- nightly sweep

    /**
     * Nightly: (1) leavers whose deactivation bypassed the trigger (imports, LDAP, setWorkflow(false)),
     * (2) resync of all open cases (assets assigned after the report, cases without assets after the
     * last working day), (3) reminders.
     * options (optional, for partial runs and tests): {userId: only this user in step 1,
     * caseQuery: encoded query on the case table for steps 2 and 3}
     */
    sweep: function (options) {
        options = options || {};
        try {
            const invalid = this._invalidAssetQuery();
            if (invalid) return invalid;
            const opened = [];
            const leavers = new GlideAggregate('alm_hardware');
            leavers.addEncodedQuery(ItamKitQuery.and(this.assetQuery, 'assigned_to.active=false',
                options.userId ? 'assigned_to=' + options.userId : ''));
            leavers.groupBy('assigned_to');
            leavers.addAggregate('COUNT');
            leavers.query();
            while (leavers.next()) {
                const userId = leavers.getValue('assigned_to');
                if (this.findOpenCase(userId)) continue;
                const result = this.resolve(userId, 'nightly_sweep');
                if (result.status_code === 201) opened.push(result.data.case_number);
            }

            let tasksAdded = 0;
            let closed = 0;
            const open = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
            open.addActiveQuery();
            if (options.caseQuery) open.addEncodedQuery(options.caseQuery);
            open.query();
            while (open.next()) {
                const sync = this.syncTasks(open);
                if (sync.success) {
                    tasksAdded += sync.data.tasks_created;
                    if (sync.data.closed) closed++;
                }
            }
            const reminders = this.sendDueReminders(options.caseQuery);
            const data = {cases_opened: opened, tasks_added: tasksAdded, cases_closed: closed, reminders: reminders.data};
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, 'Sweep: ' + opened.length + ' case(s) opened, ' + tasksAdded + ' task(s) added, ' +
                closed + ' case(s) closed, ' + reminders.data.sent + ' reminder(s), ' + reminders.data.escalations + ' escalation(s)', data);
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'LeaverAssetResolver.sweep');
        }
    },

    /**
     * Reminders on the configured days after the last working day (default 3, 7, 14).
     * The leaver is inactive and receives no mail; the reminder goes to the manager, the
     * HR contact and the optional private address. The last day is the escalation: also
     * to the manager's manager (sys_user.manager), case priority high.
     */
    sendDueReminders: function (caseQuery) {
        const today = this._today();
        const escalationDay = this.reminderDays[this.reminderDays.length - 1];
        let sent = 0;
        let escalations = 0;
        const details = [];
        const leaverCase = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
        leaverCase.addActiveQuery();
        leaverCase.addNotNullQuery('last_working_day');
        if (caseQuery) leaverCase.addEncodedQuery(caseQuery);
        leaverCase.query();
        while (leaverCase.next()) {
            const overdue = this._daysBetween(leaverCase.getValue('last_working_day'), today);
            const due = this.reminderDays.filter(function (d) { return d <= overdue; }).pop();
            const level = parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('reminder_level') || '0', 10);
            if (!due || due <= level) continue;

            const escalation = due === escalationDay;
            const recipients = this._recipients(leaverCase, escalation);
            leaverCase.setValue('reminder_level', due);
            leaverCase.setValue('last_reminder', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
            if (escalation) {
                leaverCase.setValue('escalated', true);
                leaverCase.setValue('priority', LeaverAssetResolver.PRIORITY_HIGH);
            }
            leaverCase.work_notes = (escalation ? 'Escalation' : 'Reminder') + ' day ' + due + ' (' + overdue +
                ' days after the last working day) to: ' + (recipients.labels.join(', ') || 'nobody (no manager, no HR contact)');
            leaverCase.update();
            if (recipients.ids.length) {
                gs.eventQueue(ItamKitConfig.event(escalation ? 'leaver.escalation' : 'leaver.reminder'),
                    leaverCase, recipients.ids.join(','), String(due));
            }
            if (escalation) {
                escalations++;
            } else {
                sent++;
            }
            details.push({case_id: leaverCase.getUniqueValue(), case_number: leaverCase.getValue('number'), day: due,
                escalation: escalation, recipients: recipients.ids, recipient_names: recipients.labels});
        }
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, sent + ' reminder(s), ' + escalations + ' escalation(s)',
            {sent: sent, escalations: escalations, details: details});
    },

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------- KPIs

    /**
     * Return rate and cycle time of closed cases (optional extra encoded query on the case table).
     * return_rate = returned assets / assets of closed cases; cycle time = calendar days from the
     * last working day to the closure of the case; on time = closed by the escalation day.
     */
    kpis: function (query) {
        try {
            const target = this.reminderDays[this.reminderDays.length - 1];
            const k = {cases_closed: 0, cases_open: 0, assets_total: 0, assets_returned: 0, assets_lost: 0,
                return_rate: null, avg_cycle_days: null, max_cycle_days: null, on_time_rate: null, target_days: target};
            let cycleSum = 0;
            let onTime = 0;
            const leaverCase = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
            if (query) leaverCase.addEncodedQuery(query);
            leaverCase.query();
            while (leaverCase.next()) {
                if (ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.active)) {
                    k.cases_open++;
                    continue;
                }
                k.cases_closed++;
                k.assets_total += parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('assets_total') || '0', 10);
                k.assets_returned += parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('assets_returned') || '0', 10);
                k.assets_lost += parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('assets_lost') || '0', 10);
                const cycle = parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('cycle_time_days') || '0', 10);
                cycleSum += cycle;
                k.max_cycle_days = Math.max(k.max_cycle_days || 0, cycle);
                if (cycle <= target) onTime++;
            }
            if (k.assets_total) k.return_rate = Math.round(10000 * k.assets_returned / k.assets_total) / 100;
            if (k.cases_closed) {
                k.avg_cycle_days = Math.round(10 * cycleSum / k.cases_closed) / 10;
                k.on_time_rate = Math.round(10000 * onTime / k.cases_closed) / 100;
            }
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, k.cases_closed + ' closed case(s): return rate ' + k.return_rate + ' %, average cycle time ' +
                k.avg_cycle_days + ' day(s)', k);
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'LeaverAssetResolver.kpis');
        }
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    _createCase: function (user, source, options) {
        const leaverCase = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
        leaverCase.initialize();
        this._fillCase(leaverCase, user, source, options);
        leaverCase.insert();
        leaverCase.get(leaverCase.getUniqueValue());
        return leaverCase;
    },

    _fillCase: function (leaverCase, user, source, options) {
        const reported = !!options.lastWorkingDay;
        const lastWorkingDay = options.lastWorkingDay || this._today();
        leaverCase.setValue('leaver', user.getUniqueValue());
        leaverCase.setValue('trigger_source', source || 'manual');
        leaverCase.setValue('manager', user.getValue('manager'));
        leaverCase.setValue('company', user.getValue('company'));
        this._setLastWorkingDay(leaverCase, lastWorkingDay, !reported);
        if (options.hrContact) leaverCase.setValue('hr_contact', options.hrContact);
        if (options.privateEmail) leaverCase.setValue('private_email', options.privateEmail);
        if (this.assignmentGroup) leaverCase.setValue('assignment_group', this.assignmentGroup);
        leaverCase.setValue('short_description', 'Asset return for leaver ' + user.getDisplayValue());
    },

    /** Last working day, estimated flag and the due date (end of that day, local time) of the case and its open tasks. */
    _setLastWorkingDay: function (leaverCase, lastWorkingDay, estimated) {
        const due = new GlideDateTime();
        due.setDisplayValueInternal(lastWorkingDay + ' 23:59:59');
        leaverCase.setValue('last_working_day', lastWorkingDay);
        leaverCase.setValue('lwd_estimated', estimated);
        leaverCase.setValue('due_date', due.getValue());
        if (leaverCase.isNewRecord()) return;
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        task.addQuery('parent', leaverCase.getUniqueValue());
        task.addActiveQuery();
        task.query();
        while (task.next()) {
            task.setValue('due_date', due.getValue());
            task.update();
        }
    },

    _assignedAssets: function (userId) {
        const assets = [];
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        asset.addQuery('assigned_to', userId);
        asset.addEncodedQuery(this.assetQuery);
        asset.orderBy('asset_tag');
        asset.query();
        while (asset.next()) {
            assets.push({sys_id: asset.getUniqueValue(), display: asset.getDisplayValue(), model: asset.getValue('model')});
        }
        return assets;
    },

    _invalidAssetQuery: function () {
        const problems = ItamKitQuery.problems('alm_hardware', this.assetQuery);
        if (!problems.length) return null;
        return ItamKitResult.fail(422, 'Property leaver.asset_query is invalid: ' + problems.join('; '));
    },

    /** Recounts the tasks of a case; closes it when no task is open (and, without assets, after the last working day). */
    _updateCounters: function (caseId) {
        const counts = {total: 0, open: 0, returned: 0, lost: 0};
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        task.addQuery('parent', caseId);
        task.query();
        while (task.next()) {
            counts.total++;
            if (ItamKitConfig.isTrue(task.active)) counts.open++;
            const outcome = LeaverAssetResolver.OUTCOMES[task.getValue(this.outcomeField)];
            if (outcome && outcome.returned) counts.returned++;
            if (outcome && !outcome.returned) counts.lost++;
        }
        const leaverCase = new GlideRecord(this.caseTable);
        leaverCase.get(caseId);
        leaverCase.setValue('assets_total', counts.total);
        leaverCase.setValue('assets_open', counts.open);
        leaverCase.setValue('assets_returned', counts.returned);
        leaverCase.setValue('assets_lost', counts.lost);
        leaverCase.setValue('return_rate', counts.total ? Math.round(10000 * counts.returned / counts.total) / 100 : '');

        const today = this._today();
        const afterLastDay = this._daysBetween(leaverCase.getValue('last_working_day') || today, today) > 0;
        let closed = false;
        if (ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.active) && counts.open === 0 && (counts.total > 0 || afterLastDay)) {
            leaverCase.setValue('state', counts.lost ? LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE : LeaverAssetResolver.TASK_CLOSED_COMPLETE);
            leaverCase.setValue('cycle_time_days', Math.max(0, this._daysBetween(leaverCase.getValue('last_working_day') || today, today)));
            leaverCase.setValue('close_notes', counts.total ? counts.returned + ' of ' + counts.total + ' asset(s) returned, ' + counts.lost + ' missing/lost.'
                : 'No hardware was assigned to the leaver after the last working day.');
            closed = true;
        }
        leaverCase.update();
        return {tasks_total: counts.total, tasks_open: counts.open, assets_returned: counts.returned, assets_lost: counts.lost, closed: closed};
    },

    _recipients: function (leaverCase, escalation) {
        const ids = [];
        const labels = [];
        const add = function (element) {
            if (element.nil() || ids.indexOf(element.toString()) >= 0) return;
            if (!ItamKitConfig.isTrue(element.active)) {
                labels.push(element.getDisplayValue() + ' (inactive, skipped)');
                return;
            }
            ids.push(element.toString());
            labels.push(element.getDisplayValue());
        };
        add(leaverCase.manager.getRefRecord().isValidRecord() ? leaverCase.manager : leaverCase.leaver.manager);
        add(leaverCase.hr_contact);
        if (escalation) add(leaverCase.manager.manager);
        const privateEmail = leaverCase.getValue('private_email');
        if (privateEmail) {
            ids.push(privateEmail);
            labels.push('private address');
        }
        return {ids: ids, labels: labels};
    },

    _assetState: function (asset) {
        return {install_status: asset.getValue('install_status'), substatus: asset.getValue('substatus'),
            assigned_to: asset.getValue('assigned_to'), stockroom: asset.getValue('stockroom')};
    },

    _today: function () {
        return new GlideDateTime().getLocalDate().getValue();
    },

    /** Calendar days from date a to date b ('yyyy-MM-dd'), negative if b is earlier. */
    _daysBetween: function (a, b) {
        const parse = function (s) {
            const p = String(s).substring(0, 10).split('-');
            return Date.UTC(parseInt(p[0], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[2], 10));
        };
        return Math.round((parse(b) - parse(a)) / 86400000);
    },

    type: 'LeaverAssetResolver'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>bdf26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013104</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LeaverAssetResolver</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_bdf26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013104</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 12:36:38</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fix_0e0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013117
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>15 generic DQ rules and the scorecard «All companies»; idempotent</description><name>ITAM Toolkit: seed generic DQ rules</name><record_for_rollback>false</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Fix script «ITAM Toolkit: seed generic DQ rules».
 * 15 generic rules on base tables (no customer data, no company names) and the scorecard
 * «All companies». Idempotent: rules are matched by code; existing rules keep their
 * active flag and weight, everything else is refreshed. Run once after installing the app.
 */
(function () {
    const END_USER = 'sys_class_nameINcmdb_ci_computer,cmdb_ci_hardware';
    const RULES = [
        // code, group, dimension, weight, table, type, population, defect, field, compare, name, remediation
        ['C01', 'ci', 'completeness', 3, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', '', 'serial_numberISEMPTY', '', '',
            'CI without serial number', 'Take the serial number from the inventory or discovery source; without it the IRE cannot match the device.'],
        ['C02', 'ci', 'completeness', 2, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', '', 'locationISEMPTY', '', '',
            'CI without location', 'Set the location in the authoritative source (inventory export), not in the CMDB.'],
        ['C03', 'ci', 'uniqueness', 3, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'duplicate', '', '', 'serial_number', '',
            'Duplicate serial number', 'Merge the duplicate CIs (CMDB de-duplication task) and check the identification rule of the source.'],
        ['C04', 'ci', 'consistency', 2, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'field_mismatch', '', '', 'manufacturer', 'model_id.manufacturer',
            'Manufacturer differs from the model\'s manufacturer', 'Normalise the manufacturer name (e.g. «DELL» -> «Dell Inc.») at the import.'],
        ['C05', 'ci', 'completeness', 3, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', END_USER + '^install_statusIN1,3', 'assigned_toISEMPTY', '', '',
            'End-user device in use without assigned user', 'Assign the user or set the device to In stock.'],
        ['C06', 'ci', 'consistency', 2, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', END_USER + '^install_status=7', 'assigned_toISNOTEMPTY', '', '',
            'Retired end-user device still assigned', 'Remove the assignment when retiring the device.'],
        ['C07', 'ci', 'consistency', 3, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', 'install_statusIN1,3^assigned_toISNOTEMPTY', 'assigned_to.active=false', '', '',
            'Device in use by an inactive user (leaver)', 'Open a leaver case (module 1) so the asset is returned.'],
        ['C08', 'ci', 'completeness', 1, 'cmdb_ci_hardware', 'query', '', 'model_idISEMPTY', '', '',
            'CI without model', 'Map the model at the import (model master data).'],
        ['A01', 'asset', 'completeness', 2, 'alm_hardware', 'query', '', 'serial_numberISEMPTY', '', '',
            'Hardware asset without serial number', 'Complete the serial number from the delivery note or the CI.'],
        ['A02', 'asset', 'completeness', 1, 'alm_hardware', 'query', 'install_statusIN1,3,6', 'warranty_expirationISEMPTY', '', '',
            'Active asset without warranty date', 'Enter the warranty end from the purchase order or the vendor portal.'],
        ['A03', 'asset', 'uniqueness', 2, 'alm_hardware', 'duplicate', '', '', 'asset_tag', '',
            'Duplicate asset tag', 'Re-label one of the devices; asset tags must be unique.'],
        ['A04', 'asset', 'consistency', 2, 'alm_hardware', 'query', 'install_statusIN6,7', 'assigned_toISNOTEMPTY', '', '',
            'Asset in stock or retired but still assigned', 'Clear the assignment; only assets in use are assigned.'],
        ['X01', 'asset_ci', 'consistency', 3, 'alm_hardware', 'drift', '', '', '', '',
            'Asset status differs from CI status (OOTB mapping)', 'Open the drift finding and fix it with the leading side.'],
        ['U01', 'user', 'completeness', 2, 'sys_user', 'query', 'active=true', 'managerISEMPTY', '', '',
            'Active user without manager', 'Maintain the manager in the HR source; escalations follow sys_user.manager.'],
        ['U02', 'user', 'completeness', 1, 'sys_user', 'query', 'active=true', 'departmentISEMPTY', '', '',
            'Active user without department', 'Maintain the department in the HR source.']
    ];

    const table = gs.getCurrentScopeName() + '_dq_rule';
    let created = 0;
    let updated = 0;
    RULES.forEach(function (r, i) {
        const rule = new GlideRecord(table);
        const exists = rule.get('code', r[0]);
        if (!exists) {
            rule.initialize();
            rule.setValue('code', r[0]);
            rule.setValue('active', true);
            rule.setValue('weight', r[3]);
        }
        rule.setValue('rule_group', r[1]);
        rule.setValue('dimension', r[2]);
        rule.setValue('table_name', r[4]);
        rule.setValue('rule_type', r[5]);
        rule.setValue('population_query', r[6]);
        rule.setValue('defect_query', r[7]);
        rule.setValue('field', r[8]);
        rule.setValue('compare_field', r[9]);
        rule.setValue('company_field', 'company');
        rule.setValue('name', r[10]);
        rule.setValue('remediation', r[11]);
        rule.setValue('order', (i + 1) * 10);
        if (exists) {
            rule.update();
            updated++;
        } else {
            rule.insert();
            created++;
        }
    });

    const card = new GlideRecord(gs.getCurrentScopeName() + '_dq_scorecard');
    if (!card.get('name', 'All companies')) {
        card.initialize();
        card.setValue('name', 'All companies');
        card.setValue('active', true);
        card.setValue('description', 'All records of the instance, no company filter.');
        card.insert();
    }
    gs.info('ITAM Toolkit DQ rules: ' + created + ' created, ' + updated + ' updated');
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>0e0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013117</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM Toolkit: seed generic DQ rules</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_0e0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013117</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:43</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_71f22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131e5
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitRest</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Shared code of the Scripted REST API</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitRest</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitRest: shared code of the Scripted REST API «ITAM Toolkit» (API ID toolkit).
 * Every resource answers with the ItamKitResult contract as JSON body; the HTTP status is
 * the status_code, except 204 and 208, which are sent as 200 so the body arrives.
 */
var ItamKitRest = Class.create();

/** Returns a 403 result if the caller lacks the toolkit role, else null. */
ItamKitRest.guard = function (roleSuffix) {
    const role = ItamKitConfig.role(roleSuffix);
    if (gs.hasRole(role)) return null;
    return ItamKitResult.fail(403, 'Role ' + role + ' required');
};

ItamKitRest.param = function (request, name, fallback) {
    const value = request.queryParams[name];
    return value && value.length ? String(value[0]) : fallback;
};

ItamKitRest.send = function (response, result) {
    const http = (result.status_code === 204 || result.status_code === 208) ? 200 : result.status_code;
    response.setContentType('application/json');
    response.setStatus(http);
    // JSON.stringify instead of returning the object: otherwise integers arrive as 5.0
    response.getStreamWriter().writeString(JSON.stringify(result));
};

/** Runs a handler with role check and error contract. */
ItamKitRest.handle = function (request, response, roleSuffix, handler) {
    let result = ItamKitRest.guard(roleSuffix);
    if (!result) {
        try {
            result = handler();
        } catch (e) {
            result = ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'REST ' + request.uri);
        }
    }
    ItamKitRest.send(response, result);
};

ItamKitRest.prototype = {
    type: 'ItamKitRest'
};

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_0113a3ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131dd
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>dq run</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/** POST /dq/run?name=<scorecard>: drift scan for the scorecard's company, then a new snapshot; role admin. */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    ItamKitRest.handle(request, response, 'admin', function () {
        const dq = new DqScorecard();
        const card = dq._scorecard(ItamKitRest.param(request, 'name', ''));
        if (!card) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Scorecard not found');
        const drift = new AssetCiDrift().scan(card.getValue('company'));
        const run = dq.run(card.getUniqueValue(), 'api');
        run.data = Object.assign({drift: drift}, run.data);
        return run;
    });
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_371499_itamkit/toolkit/dq/run</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/dq/run</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>0113a3ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131dd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>dq run</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_0113a3ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131dd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:55</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ITAM Toolkit">4f0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131a4</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

12:36:39</sys_updated_on><value>/**
 * ATF test «ITAM Toolkit: leaver asset return», step «Run Server Side Script» (Jasmine 3.1).
 * Module 1: triggers (a) API/producer path, (b) deactivation, (c) nightly sweep; the four end
 * states; idempotency; reminders and escalation; KPIs. The test creates its own users and
 * devices; ATF rolls all changes back after the run.
 */
(function (outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    const resolver = new LeaverAssetResolver();
    const CASE = ItamKitConfig.table('leaver_case');
    const OUTCOME = ItamKitConfig.outcomeField();
    const stamp = String(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue());

    function newUser(name, managerId, inactive) {
        const user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        user.initialize();
        user.setValue('user_name', 'atf.itamkit.' + name + '.' + stamp);
        user.setValue('first_name', 'ATF');
        user.setValue('last_name', name);
        user.setValue('email', 'atf.' + name + '@example.com');
        if (managerId) user.setValue('manager', managerId);
        if (inactive) user.setValue('active', false);
        return user.insert();
    }

    function newDevice(name, userId) {
        const ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_computer');
        ci.initialize();
        ci.setValue('name', 'ATF-' + name + '-' + stamp);
        ci.setValue('install_status', '1');
        ci.setValue('assigned_to', userId);
        const ciId = ci.insert();
        // The platform rule «Create Asset on insert» may already have created the asset.
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        if (!asset.get('ci', ciId)) {
            asset.initialize();
            asset.setValue('ci', ciId);
        }
        asset.setValue('asset_tag', 'ATF-' + name + '-' + stamp);
        asset.setValue('install_status', '1');
        asset.setValue('assigned_to', userId);
        return asset.isNewRecord() ? asset.insert() : (asset.update(), asset.getUniqueValue());
    }

    function load(table, id) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.get(id);
        return gr;
    }

    function tasksOf(caseId) {
        const ids = [];
        const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
        task.addQuery('parent', caseId);
        task.orderBy('number');
        task.query();
        while (task.next()) ids.push(task.getUniqueValue());
        return ids;
    }

    function daysAgo(n) {
        const d = new GlideDateTime();
        d.addDaysLocalTime(-n);
        return d.getLocalDate().getValue();
    }

    describe('resolve() (API / record producer path)', function () {
        it('opens one case with one return task per assigned device and is idempotent', function () {
            const boss = newUser('boss');
            const hr = newUser('hr');
            const leaver = newUser('leaver1', boss);
            newDevice('NB1', leaver);
            newDevice('NB2', leaver);
            newDevice('PH1', leaver);
            newDevice('OTHER', newUser('colleague'));

            const first = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual', {lastWorkingDay: daysAgo(1), hrContact: hr});
            expect(first.success).toBe(true);
            expect(first.status_code).toBe(201);
            expect(first.data.tasks_total).toBe(3);
            const leaverCase = load(CASE, first.data.case_id);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('leaver')).toBe(leaver);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('manager')).toBe(boss);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('hr_contact')).toBe(hr);
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.lwd_estimated)).toBe(false);

            const due = leaverCase.getValue('due_date');
            const later = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual', {lastWorkingDay: daysAgo(0)});
            expect(later.status_code).toBe(208);
            expect(load(CASE, first.data.case_id).getValue('due_date')).not.toBe(due);
            const task = new GlideRecord('asset_task');
            task.addQuery('parent', first.data.case_id);
            task.query();
            task.next();
            expect(task.getValue('due_date')).toBe(load(CASE, first.data.case_id).getValue('due_date'));

            const second = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual');
            expect(second.status_code).toBe(208);
            expect(second.data.case_id).toBe(first.data.case_id);
            expect(tasksOf(first.data.case_id).length).toBe(3);
        });

        it('answers 204 for a user without hardware and 404 for an unknown user', function () {
            expect(resolver.resolve(newUser('nohardware'), 'manual').status_code).toBe(204);
            expect(resolver.resolve('0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef', 'manual').status_code).toBe(404);
        });
    });

    describe('completeReturn(): end states and KPIs', function () {
        it('sets In stock / Pending repair / Pending disposal / Missing and closes the case', function () {
            const leaver = newUser('leaver2');
            const assets = [newDevice('R1', leaver), newDevice('R2', leaver), newDevice('R3', leaver), newDevice('R4', leaver)];
            const lastDay = daysAgo(2);
            const opened = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual', {lastWorkingDay: lastDay});
            const tasks = tasksOf(opened.data.case_id);
            expect(tasks.length).toBe(4);

            const outcomes = ['in_stock', 'pending_repair', 'pending_disposal', 'missing_lost'];
            tasks.forEach(function (taskId, i) {
                const result = resolver.completeReturn(taskId, outcomes[i]);
                expect(result.success).toBe(true);
                expect(result.status_code).toBe(200);
            });

            const byTask = {};
            tasks.forEach(function (taskId) {
                const task = load('asset_task', taskId);
                byTask[task.getValue(OUTCOME)] = load('alm_hardware', task.getValue('asset'));
            });
            expect(byTask.in_stock.getValue('install_status')).toBe('6');
            expect(byTask.in_stock.getValue('substatus')).toBe('available');
            expect(byTask.in_stock.assigned_to.nil()).toBe(true);
            expect(byTask.pending_repair.getValue('substatus')).toBe('pending_repair');
            expect(byTask.pending_disposal.getValue('substatus')).toBe('pending_disposal');
            expect(byTask.missing_lost.getValue('install_status')).toBe('8');
            expect(byTask.missing_lost.getValue('substatus')).toBe('lost');
            expect(byTask.missing_lost.getValue('assigned_to')).toBe(leaver);

            const leaverCase = load(CASE, opened.data.case_id);
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.active)).toBe(false);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('state')).toBe('4');
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('assets_returned')).toBe('3');
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('assets_lost')).toBe('1');
            expect(parseFloat(leaverCase.getValue('return_rate'))).toBe(75);
            expect(parseInt(leaverCase.getValue('cycle_time_days'), 10)).toBe(2);

            const audit = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('audit_log'));
            audit.addQuery('target_id', 'IN', assets.join(','));
            audit.addQuery('module', 'leaver');
            audit.query();
            expect(audit.getRowCount()).toBeGreaterThan(3);

            const kpi = resolver.kpis('sys_id=' + opened.data.case_id);
            expect(kpi.data.cases_closed).toBe(1);
            expect(kpi.data.return_rate).toBe(75);
            expect(kpi.data.avg_cycle_days).toBe(2);
        });

        it('is idempotent and validates the outcome', function () {
            const leaver = newUser('leaver3');
            newDevice('V1', leaver);
            const opened = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual');
            const taskId = tasksOf(opened.data.case_id)[0];
            expect(resolver.completeReturn(taskId, 'sold').status_code).toBe(400);
            expect(resolver.completeReturn(taskId, 'in_stock').status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(resolver.completeReturn(taskId, 'in_stock').status_code).toBe(208);
            expect(resolver.completeReturn(taskId, 'missing_lost').status_code).toBe(409);
        });
    });

    describe('triggers (b) deactivation and (c) nightly sweep', function () {
        it('opens a case when the user is deactivated', function () {
            const leaver = newUser('leaver4');
            newDevice('D1', leaver);
            const user = load('sys_user', leaver);
            user.setValue('active', false);
            user.update();
            const leaverCase = resolver.findOpenCase(leaver);
            expect(leaverCase).not.toBeNull();
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('trigger_source')).toBe('user_deactivated');
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.lwd_estimated)).toBe(true);
            expect(tasksOf(leaverCase.getUniqueValue()).length).toBe(1);
        });

        it('catches a leaver whose deactivation never fired the trigger (e.g. loaded inactive by an import)', function () {
            // Scoped apps may not call setWorkflow(false) on sys_user; a user inserted as inactive
            // bypasses the «active changes to false» trigger in the same way.
            const leaver = newUser('leaver5', '', true);
            newDevice('S1', leaver);
            expect(resolver.findOpenCase(leaver)).toBeNull();

            const sweep = resolver.sweep({userId: leaver, caseQuery: 'leaver=' + leaver});
            expect(sweep.success).toBe(true);
            expect(sweep.data.cases_opened.length).toBe(1);
            const leaverCase = resolver.findOpenCase(leaver);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('trigger_source')).toBe('nightly_sweep');
            expect(resolver.sweep({userId: leaver, caseQuery: 'leaver=' + leaver}).data.cases_opened.length).toBe(0);
        });
    });

    describe('reminders on day 3 / 7 / 14', function () {
        it('reminds manager and HR, then escalates to the manager\'s manager', function () {
            const director = newUser('director');
            const boss = newUser('boss2', director);
            const hr = newUser('hr2');
            const leaver = newUser('leaver6', boss);
            newDevice('M1', leaver);
            const opened = resolver.resolve(leaver, 'manual', {lastWorkingDay: daysAgo(8), hrContact: hr});
            const caseId = opened.data.case_id;
            const onlyThisCase = 'sys_id=' + caseId;

            const first = resolver.sendDueReminders(onlyThisCase);
            expect(first.data.sent).toBe(1);
            expect(first.data.escalations).toBe(0);
            let leaverCase = load(CASE, caseId);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('reminder_level')).toBe('7');
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.escalated)).toBe(false);
            const reminder = first.data.details[0];
            expect(reminder.day).toBe(7);
            expect(reminder.recipients).toContain(boss);
            expect(reminder.recipients).toContain(hr);
            expect(reminder.recipients).not.toContain(director);
            expect(reminder.recipients).not.toContain(leaver);

            expect(resolver.sendDueReminders(onlyThisCase).data.sent).toBe(0);

            leaverCase.setValue('last_working_day', daysAgo(15));
            leaverCase.update();
            const second = resolver.sendDueReminders(onlyThisCase);
            expect(second.data.escalations).toBe(1);
            leaverCase = load(CASE, caseId);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('reminder_level')).toBe('14');
            expect(ItamKitConfig.isTrue(leaverCase.escalated)).toBe(true);
            expect(leaverCase.getValue('priority')).toBe('2');
            expect(second.data.details[0].escalation).toBe(true);
            expect(second.data.details[0].recipients).toContain(director);
            expect(second.data.details[0].recipients).toContain(boss);
        });
    });

    describe('configuration guard', function () {
        it('rejects queries with unknown fields instead of ignoring them silently', function () {
            expect(ItamKitQuery.problems('alm_hardware', 'install_statusNOT IN6,7,8').length).toBe(0);
            expect(ItamKitQuery.problems('alm_hardware', 'assigned_to.active=false').length).toBe(0);
            expect(ItamKitQuery.problems('alm_hardware', 'assigned_to.actve=false').length).toBe(1);
            expect(ItamKitQuery.problems('alm_hardware', 'install_status=1^NQactive=true').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

jasmine.getEnv().execute();

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_0ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013112
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.DqScorecard</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Module 2: weighted data quality score from the rule table</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DqScorecard</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * DqScorecard: weighted data quality score from a configurable rule table.
 *
 * Rule (<scope>_dq_rule): table, rule type, population query, defect query, dimension,
 * weight, group, remediation hint. Rule types:
 *   query          defects = population AND defect query
 *   duplicate      defects = surplus records sharing a non-empty value of duplicate_field
 *   field_mismatch defects = records where field and compare_field are both set and differ
 *   drift          defects = assets whose CI status differs from the OOTB asset/CI status mapping
 * Rule score = 100 * (1 - defects / population); rules with an empty population are skipped.
 * Scorecard score = sum(weight * rule score) / sum(weight).
 *
 * A scorecard (<scope>_dq_scorecard) can be limited to one company: the engine adds
 * "<company_field>=<company>" to every rule. Each run writes a snapshot
 * (<scope>_dq_snapshot) with one result row per rule (<scope>_dq_result); the trend is a
 * line report on the snapshots, without Performance Analytics.
 */
var DqScorecard = Class.create();

DqScorecard.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.ruleTable = ItamKitConfig.table('dq_rule');
        this.scorecardTable = ItamKitConfig.table('dq_scorecard');
        this.snapshotTable = ItamKitConfig.table('dq_snapshot');
        this.resultTable = ItamKitConfig.table('dq_result');
    },

    /** Runs all active rules for a scorecard (sys_id or name) and stores a snapshot. */
    run: function (scorecard, trigger) {
        try {
            const card = this._scorecard(scorecard);
            if (!card) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Scorecard not found: ' + scorecard);
            const started = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();
            const companyId = card.getValue('company');

            const snapshot = new GlideRecord(this.snapshotTable);
            snapshot.initialize();
            snapshot.setValue('scorecard', card.getUniqueValue());
            snapshot.setValue('trigger', trigger || 'manual');
            snapshot.setValue('snapshot_label', card.getValue('name') + ' ' + new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue());
            const snapshotId = snapshot.insert();

            let weighted = 0;
            let weights = 0;
            const counts = {evaluated: 0, invalid: 0, empty: 0, population: 0, defects: 0};
            const rows = [];
            const rule = new GlideRecord(this.ruleTable);
            rule.addActiveQuery();
            rule.orderBy('order');
            rule.orderBy('name');
            rule.query();
            while (rule.next()) {
                const r = this.evaluate(rule, companyId);
                const weight = parseInt(rule.getValue('weight') || '1', 10);
                const result = new GlideRecord(this.resultTable);
                result.initialize();
                result.setValue('snapshot', snapshotId);
                result.setValue('rule', rule.getUniqueValue());
                result.setValue('status', r.status);
                result.setValue('weight', weight);
                result.setValue('dimension', rule.getValue('dimension'));
                result.setValue('rule_group', rule.getValue('rule_group'));
                result.setValue('message', r.message);
                if (r.status === 'ok') {
                    result.setValue('population', r.population);
                    result.setValue('defects', r.defects);
                    result.setValue('score', this._round(r.score));
                    weighted += weight * r.score;
                    weights += weight;
                    counts.evaluated++;
                    counts.population += r.population;
                    counts.defects += r.defects;
                } else {
                    counts[r.status]++;
                }
                result.insert();
                rows.push({code: rule.getValue('code'), rule: rule.getValue('name'), status: r.status, population: r.population, defects: r.defects,
                    score: r.status === 'ok' ? this._round(r.score) : null, weight: weight, message: r.message});
            }

            const score = weights ? this._round(weighted / weights) : null;
            snapshot.get(snapshotId);
            snapshot.setValue('score', score === null ? '' : score);
            snapshot.setValue('rules_evaluated', counts.evaluated);
            snapshot.setValue('rules_invalid', counts.invalid);
            snapshot.setValue('rules_empty', counts.empty);
            snapshot.setValue('population_total', counts.population);
            snapshot.setValue('defects_total', counts.defects);
            snapshot.setValue('duration_ms', new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() - started);
            snapshot.update();

            const message = card.getValue('name') + ': score ' + score + ' from ' + counts.evaluated + ' rule(s)' +
                (counts.invalid ? ', ' + counts.invalid + ' invalid rule(s) skipped' : '') +
                (counts.empty ? ', ' + counts.empty + ' rule(s) without population' : '');
            const data = {snapshot_id: snapshotId, snapshot: snapshot.getDisplayValue(), score: score, counts: counts, rules: rows};
            return counts.invalid ? ItamKitResult.fail(422, message, data) : ItamKitResult.ok(201, message, data);
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'DqScorecard.run');
        }
    },

    /** Evaluates one rule: {status: ok|invalid|empty, population, defects, score, message}. */
    evaluate: function (rule, companyId) {
        const table = rule.getValue('table_name');
        const type = rule.getValue('rule_type') || 'query';
        const companyField = rule.getValue('company_field');
        const scope = companyId && companyField ? companyField + '=' + companyId : '';
        const population = ItamKitQuery.and(scope, rule.getValue('population_query'));
        const defectQuery = rule.getValue('defect_query');

        const problems = ItamKitQuery.problems(table, population)
            .concat(type === 'query' ? ItamKitQuery.problems(table, defectQuery) : []);
        if (type === 'query' && !defectQuery) problems.push('defect query is empty');
        if (type === 'duplicate' && !ItamKitQuery.isValidPath(table, rule.getValue('field') || '')) problems.push('duplicate field is not valid');
        if (type === 'field_mismatch') {
            if (!ItamKitQuery.isValidPath(table, rule.getValue('field') || '')) problems.push('field is not valid');
            if (!ItamKitQuery.isValidPath(table, rule.getValue('compare_field') || '')) problems.push('compare field is not valid');
        }
        if (type === 'drift' && table !== 'alm_hardware') problems.push('drift rules run on alm_hardware');
        if (problems.length) return {status: 'invalid', message: problems.join('; ')};

        let population_count;
        let defects;
        if (type === 'drift') {
            const drift = new AssetCiDrift().count(companyId).data;
            population_count = drift.population;
            defects = drift.defects;
        } else {
            population_count = this._count(table, population);
            if (type === 'query') defects = this._count(table, ItamKitQuery.and(population, defectQuery));
            if (type === 'duplicate') defects = this._duplicates(table, population, rule.getValue('field'));
            if (type === 'field_mismatch') defects = this._mismatches(table, population, rule.getValue('field'), rule.getValue('compare_field'));
        }
        if (!population_count) return {status: 'empty', population: 0, defects: 0, message: 'no records in the population'};
        return {status: 'ok', population: population_count, defects: defects,
            score: 100 * (1 - defects / population_count), message: defects + ' of ' + population_count};
    },

    /** Latest snapshot of a scorecard with its results and the rule definitions (for the REST API). */
    latest: function (scorecard) {
        const card = this._scorecard(scorecard);
        if (!card) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Scorecard not found: ' + scorecard);
        const snapshot = new GlideRecord(this.snapshotTable);
        snapshot.addQuery('scorecard', card.getUniqueValue());
        snapshot.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        snapshot.setLimit(1);
        snapshot.query();
        if (!snapshot.next()) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'No snapshot yet for ' + card.getValue('name'));
        const results = [];
        const result = new GlideRecord(this.resultTable);
        result.addQuery('snapshot', snapshot.getUniqueValue());
        result.orderBy('rule.order');
        result.query();
        while (result.next()) {
            const rule = result.rule.getRefRecord();
            results.push({
                code: rule.getValue('code'), rule: rule.getValue('name'), table: rule.getValue('table_name'), rule_type: rule.getValue('rule_type'),
                population_query: rule.getValue('population_query') || '', defect_query: rule.getValue('defect_query') || '',
                field: rule.getValue('field') || '', compare_field: rule.getValue('compare_field') || '',
                company_field: rule.getValue('company_field') || '', dimension: rule.getValue('dimension'),
                rule_group: rule.getValue('rule_group'), remediation: rule.getValue('remediation') || '',
                status: result.getValue('status'), weight: parseInt(result.getValue('weight'), 10),
                population: result.getValue('population') === null ? null : parseInt(result.getValue('population'), 10),
                defects: result.getValue('defects') === null ? null : parseInt(result.getValue('defects'), 10),
                score: result.getValue('score') === null ? null : parseFloat(result.getValue('score'))
            });
        }
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, card.getValue('name') + ': score ' + snapshot.getValue('score') + ' (' + snapshot.getValue('sys_created_on') + ' UTC)', {
            scorecard: card.getValue('name'), company: card.getValue('company') || '', company_name: card.company.getDisplayValue(),
            snapshot: snapshot.getDisplayValue(), created_on: snapshot.getValue('sys_created_on'),
            score: snapshot.getValue('score') === null ? null : parseFloat(snapshot.getValue('score')), results: results
        });
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    _scorecard: function (scorecard) {
        const card = new GlideRecord(this.scorecardTable);
        if (scorecard && card.get(scorecard)) return card;
        card.initialize();
        card.addActiveQuery();
        if (scorecard) card.addQuery('name', scorecard);
        card.orderBy('name');
        card.setLimit(1);
        card.query();
        return card.next() ? card : null;
    },

    _count: function (table, query) {
        const agg = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (query) agg.addEncodedQuery(query);
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.query();
        return agg.next() ? parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0;
    },

    /** Surplus records: a value shared by n records counts n - 1 times. */
    _duplicates: function (table, query, field) {
        let surplus = 0;
        const agg = new GlideAggregate(table);
        if (query) agg.addEncodedQuery(query);
        agg.addNotNullQuery(field);
        agg.groupBy(field);
        agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
        agg.query();
        while (agg.next()) {
            const n = parseInt(agg.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
            if (n > 1) surplus += n - 1;
        }
        return surplus;
    },

    _mismatches: function (table, query, field, compareField) {
        let mismatches = 0;
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        if (query) gr.addEncodedQuery(query);
        gr.addNotNullQuery(field);
        gr.addNotNullQuery(compareField);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            if (this._value(gr, field) !== this._value(gr, compareField)) mismatches++;
        }
        return mismatches;
    },

    /** Value of a field path, dot-walk allowed ('model_id.manufacturer'). */
    _value: function (gr, path) {
        let element = gr;
        path.split('.').forEach(function (part) {
            element = element[part];
        });
        return element === undefined || element === null ? '' : element.toString();
    },

    _round: function (value) {
        return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;
    },

    type: 'DqScorecard'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:27</sys_created_on><sys_id>0ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013112</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DqScorecard</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e4013112</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:27</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
