sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_8ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e401310b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.AssetCiDrift</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Module 2: asset/CI status drift against the OOTB mapping</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AssetCiDrift</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * AssetCiDrift: watches whether a hardware asset and its CI tell the same lifecycle story.
 *
 * Target state = the platform's own table alm_asset_ci_state_mapping (Asset CI Install
 * Status Mapping, OOTB): asset install_status + substatus -> expected CI install_status.
 * Drift appears when updates bypass the platform's synchronisation (imports with business
 * rules off, setWorkflow(false), mapping entries that only sync asset -> CI).
 *
 *   scan(companyId)              one open finding per drifting asset (<scope>_drift_finding), with a preview
 *   fix(findingId, leadingSide)  'asset' or 'ci' leads; changes the other side, writes the audit log
 *   count(companyId)             population and drift count for the DQ scorecard
 * All entry points return the ItamKitResult contract.
 */
var AssetCiDrift = Class.create();

AssetCiDrift.OPEN = 'open';
AssetCiDrift.FIXED = 'fixed';
AssetCiDrift.RESOLVED = 'resolved';

AssetCiDrift.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {
        this.findingTable = ItamKitConfig.table('drift_finding');
        this.toCi = {};
        this.toAsset = {};
        this.labels = {};
        const map = new GlideRecord('alm_asset_ci_state_mapping');
        map.addActiveQuery();
        map.orderBy('asset_state');
        map.orderBy('asset_substate');
        map.query();
        while (map.next()) {
            const state = map.getValue('asset_state') || '';
            const substate = map.getValue('asset_substate') || '';
            const ci = map.getValue('configuration_item_status') || '';
            const direction = map.getValue('synch_direction') || '';
            this.toCi[state + '|' + substate] = {ci: ci, direction: direction};
            // Reverse direction (CI leads): only entries the platform itself syncs from the CI.
            if (ci && (direction === 'both' || direction === 'ci_to_asset') && !this.toAsset[ci]) {
                this.toAsset[ci] = {state: state, substate: substate};
            }
        }
    },

    /** Expected CI install_status for an asset state; null if the mapping sets no CI status. */
    expectedCiStatus: function (state, substate) {
        const entry = this.toCi[state + '|' + (substate || '')] || this.toCi[state + '|'];
        return entry && entry.ci ? entry.ci : null;
    },

    /** Asset state the platform derives from a CI status; null if there is no such mapping. */
    expectedAsset: function (ciStatus) {
        return this.toAsset[ciStatus] || null;
    },

    /** Population (assets with a CI) and drifting assets, for the DQ scorecard. */
    count: function (companyId) {
        let population = 0;
        let drift = 0;
        const asset = this._assets(companyId);
        while (asset.next()) {
            population++;
            if (this._drift(asset)) drift++;
        }
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, drift + ' of ' + population + ' asset(s) drift from their CI', {population: population, defects: drift});
    },

    /** Creates or refreshes one open finding per drifting asset; closes findings that no longer drift. */
    scan: function (companyId) {
        try {
            const open = {};
            const finding = new GlideRecord(this.findingTable);
            finding.addQuery('state', AssetCiDrift.OPEN);
            if (companyId) finding.addQuery('company', companyId);
            finding.query();
            while (finding.next()) open[finding.getValue('asset')] = finding.getUniqueValue();

            let population = 0;
            let created = 0;
            let refreshed = 0;
            const asset = this._assets(companyId);
            while (asset.next()) {
                population++;
                const drift = this._drift(asset);
                const existing = open[asset.getUniqueValue()];
                delete open[asset.getUniqueValue()];
                if (!drift) {
                    if (existing) this._close(existing, AssetCiDrift.RESOLVED, 'No longer drifting at the scan.');
                    continue;
                }
                const record = new GlideRecord(this.findingTable);
                if (existing) {
                    record.get(existing);
                    refreshed++;
                } else {
                    record.initialize();
                    record.setValue('state', AssetCiDrift.OPEN);
                    created++;
                }
                this._fill(record, asset, drift);
                if (existing) {
                    record.update();
                } else {
                    record.insert();
                }
            }
            // Open findings whose asset left the population (CI removed, asset deleted)
            let closed = 0;
            Object.keys(open).forEach(function (assetId) {
                this._close(open[assetId], AssetCiDrift.RESOLVED, 'Asset no longer has a CI.');
                closed++;
            }, this);
            const total = created + refreshed;
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, total + ' drifting asset(s) of ' + population + ' (' + created + ' new finding(s), ' + closed + ' closed)',
                {population: population, drifting: total, created: created, refreshed: refreshed, closed: closed});
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'AssetCiDrift.scan');
        }
    },

    /**
     * Fixes one finding. leadingSide 'asset': the CI gets the status the mapping expects.
     * 'ci': the asset gets the state the platform derives from the CI status.
     */
    fix: function (findingId, leadingSide) {
        try {
            if (leadingSide !== 'asset' && leadingSide !== 'ci') {
                return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Choose the leading side: asset or ci');
            }
            const finding = new GlideRecord(this.findingTable);
            if (!findingId || !finding.get(findingId)) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Drift finding not found: ' + findingId);
            if (finding.getValue('state') !== AssetCiDrift.OPEN) {
                return ItamKitResult.ok(208, finding.getDisplayValue() + ' is already ' + finding.getValue('state'));
            }
            const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
            if (!asset.get(finding.getValue('asset'))) return ItamKitResult.fail(404, 'Asset of the finding no longer exists');
            const ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci');
            if (!ci.get(asset.getValue('ci'))) return ItamKitResult.fail(409, asset.getDisplayValue() + ' no longer has a CI');

            const drift = this._drift(asset);
            if (!drift) {
                this._close(findingId, AssetCiDrift.RESOLVED, 'No longer drifting when the fix was requested.');
                return ItamKitResult.ok(208, asset.getDisplayValue() + ' no longer drifts; finding closed');
            }

            const before = {asset: this._assetSide(asset), ci: {install_status: ci.getValue('install_status')}};
            if (leadingSide === 'asset') {
                ci.setValue('install_status', drift.expectedCi);
                ci.update();
            } else {
                const target = this.expectedAsset(drift.ciStatus);
                if (!target) {
                    return ItamKitResult.fail(409, 'The platform maps no asset state to CI status ' + this._ciLabel(drift.ciStatus) +
                        '; let the asset lead instead');
                }
                asset.setValue('install_status', target.state);
                asset.setValue('substatus', target.substate);
                asset.update();
            }

            asset.get(asset.getUniqueValue());
            ci.get(ci.getUniqueValue());
            const after = {asset: this._assetSide(asset), ci: {install_status: ci.getValue('install_status')}};
            const base = {module: 'drift', action: 'fix_drift', leadingSide: leadingSide, finding: findingId};
            let changes = ItamKitAudit.logChanges(Object.assign({table: 'alm_hardware', id: asset.getUniqueValue(), display: asset.getDisplayValue()}, base),
                before.asset, after.asset);
            changes += ItamKitAudit.logChanges(Object.assign({table: ci.getValue('sys_class_name'), id: ci.getUniqueValue(), display: ci.getDisplayValue()}, base),
                before.ci, after.ci);

            const remaining = this._drift(asset);
            if (remaining) {
                return ItamKitResult.fail(409, 'Still drifting after the fix: asset ' + remaining.assetLabel + ', CI ' +
                    this._ciLabel(remaining.ciStatus) + ' (expected ' + this._ciLabel(remaining.expectedCi) + '). Check the platform rules.');
            }
            finding.setValue('state', AssetCiDrift.FIXED);
            finding.setValue('leading_side', leadingSide);
            finding.setValue('fixed_by', gs.getUserID());
            finding.setValue('fixed_on', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
            finding.setValue('resolution', (leadingSide === 'asset' ? 'Asset led' : 'CI led') + ': asset ' +
                this._assetLabel(after.asset.install_status, after.asset.substatus) + ', CI ' + this._ciLabel(after.ci.install_status) +
                ' (' + changes + ' field change(s) in the audit log).');
            finding.update();
            return ItamKitResult.ok(200, asset.getDisplayValue() + ': ' + finding.getValue('resolution'),
                {asset: after.asset, ci: after.ci, audit_rows: changes});
        } catch (e) {
            return ItamKitResult.fromError(e, 'AssetCiDrift.fix');
        }
    },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    _assets: function (companyId) {
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        asset.addNotNullQuery('ci');
        if (companyId) asset.addQuery('company', companyId);
        asset.orderBy('asset_tag');
        asset.query();
        return asset;
    },

    /** Drift details of an asset, or null if asset and CI agree (or the mapping expects nothing). */
    _drift: function (asset) {
        const state = asset.getValue('install_status') || '';
        const substate = asset.getValue('substatus') || '';
        const expected = this.expectedCiStatus(state, substate);
        const ciStatus = asset.ci.install_status.toString();
        if (!expected || expected === ciStatus) return null;
        return {state: state, substate: substate, ciStatus: ciStatus, expectedCi: expected,
            assetLabel: this._assetLabel(state, substate)};
    },

    _fill: function (record, asset, drift) {
        const reverse = this.expectedAsset(drift.ciStatus);
        record.setValue('asset', asset.getUniqueValue());
        record.setValue('ci', asset.getValue('ci'));
        record.setValue('company', asset.getValue('company'));
        record.setValue('asset_state', drift.state);
        record.setValue('asset_substate', drift.substate);
        record.setValue('ci_status', drift.ciStatus);
        record.setValue('expected_ci_status', drift.expectedCi);
        record.setValue('proposed_asset_state', reverse ? reverse.state : '');
        record.setValue('proposed_asset_substate', reverse ? reverse.substate : '');
        record.setValue('preview_asset_leads', 'CI ' + asset.ci.getDisplayValue() + ': install status ' +
            this._ciLabel(drift.ciStatus) + ' -> ' + this._ciLabel(drift.expectedCi));
        record.setValue('preview_ci_leads', reverse ? 'Asset ' + asset.getDisplayValue() + ': ' + drift.assetLabel + ' -> ' +
            this._assetLabel(reverse.state, reverse.substate) : 'Not possible: the platform maps no asset state to CI status ' + this._ciLabel(drift.ciStatus));
        record.setValue('last_seen', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        record.setValue('short_description', asset.getDisplayValue() + ': asset ' + drift.assetLabel + ', CI ' +
            this._ciLabel(drift.ciStatus) + ' (expected ' + this._ciLabel(drift.expectedCi) + ')');
    },

    _close: function (findingId, state, note) {
        const finding = new GlideRecord(this.findingTable);
        if (!finding.get(findingId)) return;
        finding.setValue('state', state);
        finding.setValue('resolution', note);
        finding.update();
    },

    _assetSide: function (asset) {
        return {install_status: asset.getValue('install_status'), substatus: asset.getValue('substatus')};
    },

    _assetLabel: function (state, substate) {
        const label = this._label('alm_asset', 'install_status', state);
        return substate ? label + ' / ' + this._label('alm_asset', 'substatus', substate) : label;
    },

    _ciLabel: function (status) {
        return this._label('cmdb_ci', 'install_status', status);
    },

    _label: function (table, element, value) {
        if (!value) return '(empty)';
        const key = table + '.' + element + '.' + value;
        if (this.labels[key] === undefined) {
            const choice = new GlideRecord('sys_choice');
            choice.addQuery('name', table);
            choice.addQuery('element', element);
            choice.addQuery('value', value);
            choice.addQuery('language', 'en');
            choice.setLimit(1);
            choice.query();
            this.labels[key] = choice.next() ? choice.getValue('label') : value;
        }
        return this.labels[key];
    },

    type: 'AssetCiDrift'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>8ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e401310b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AssetCiDrift</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_8ef26facc3ac171015b012d4e401310b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:26</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sys_user</collection><condition>current.active.changesTo(false)</condition><description>Module 1, trigger (b): user deactivated</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>ITAM Toolkit: leaver on deactivation</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business rule «ITAM Toolkit: leaver on deactivation» on sys_user, after update,
 * condition: current.active.changesTo(false).
 * Trigger (b) of module 1. Mass deactivations that bypass business rules (imports, LDAP,
 * setWorkflow(false)) are caught by the nightly sweep instead.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    const result = new LeaverAssetResolver().resolve(current.getUniqueValue(), 'user_deactivated');
    if (!result.success) {
        gs.error('ITAM Toolkit leaver on deactivation: ' + result.message);
    } else if (result.status_code === 201 && gs.getSession().isInteractive()) {
        gs.addInfoMessage(result.message);
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:39</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>450323ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013141</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM Toolkit: leaver on deactivation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_450323ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013141</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:39</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=450323ecc3ac171015b012d4e4013141"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>leaver kpi</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/** GET /leaver/kpi?company=<sys_id>: return rate and cycle time of closed leaver cases; role user. */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    ItamKitRest.handle(request, response, 'user', function () {
        const company = ItamKitRest.param(request, 'company', '');
        return new LeaverAssetResolver().kpis(company ? 'company=' + company : '');
    });
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_371499_itamkit/toolkit/leaver/kpi</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/leaver/kpi</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:44:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>ea13e3ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131eb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>leaver kpi</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_ea13e3ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131eb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:44:01</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ITAM Toolkit">4f0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131a4</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>drift mapping</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/** GET /drift/mapping: the OOTB asset/CI status mapping the drift watcher uses as target state; role user. */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    ItamKitRest.handle(request, response, 'user', function () {
        const drift = new AssetCiDrift();
        return ItamKitResult.ok(200, Object.keys(drift.toCi).length + ' mapping entries', {to_ci: drift.toCi, to_asset: drift.toAsset});
    });
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_371499_itamkit/toolkit/drift/mapping</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/drift/mapping</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>651323ecc3ac171015b012d4e401316d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>drift mapping</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_651323ecc3ac171015b012d4e401316d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:58</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ITAM Toolkit">4f0363ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131a4</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

11:50:50</sys_updated_on><value>/**
 * ATF test «ITAM Toolkit: asset/CI drift and DQ scorecard», step «Run Server Side Script» (Jasmine 3.1).
 * Module 2: target state from the OOTB mapping, scan, fix with either leading side, audit log,
 * rule types of the scorecard, invalid rules, weighted score. The test creates its own company,
 * devices and rules; ATF rolls all changes back after the run.
 */
(function (outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    const stamp = String(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue());
    const FINDING = ItamKitConfig.table('drift_finding');
    const RULE = ItamKitConfig.table('dq_rule');

    function insert(table, values) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.initialize();
        Object.keys(values).forEach(function (k) {
            gr.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        return gr.insert();
    }

    function load(table, id) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        gr.get(id);
        return gr;
    }

    function newCompany(name) {
        return insert('core_company', {name: 'ATF ' + name + ' ' + stamp});
    }

    /** CI and asset in use; returns {ci, asset}. The platform may create the asset itself («Create Asset on insert»). */
    function newPair(name, companyId, extra) {
        const ci = insert('cmdb_ci_computer', Object.assign({name: 'ATF-' + name + '-' + stamp, install_status: '1', company: companyId}, extra || {}));
        const asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        if (!asset.get('ci', ci)) {
            asset.initialize();
            asset.setValue('ci', ci);
        }
        asset.setValue('install_status', '1');
        asset.setValue('company', companyId);
        asset.setValue('asset_tag', 'ATF-' + name + '-' + stamp);
        const assetId = asset.isNewRecord() ? asset.insert() : (asset.update(), asset.getUniqueValue());
        return {ci: ci, asset: assetId};
    }

    /** Changes the CI status the way an integration would (scoped apps may not use setWorkflow(false) on cmdb_ci). */
    function forceCiStatus(ciId, status) {
        const ci = load('cmdb_ci', ciId);
        ci.setValue('install_status', status);
        ci.update();
    }

    function openFinding(assetId) {
        const finding = new GlideRecord(FINDING);
        finding.addQuery('asset', assetId);
        finding.addQuery('state', 'open');
        finding.query();
        return finding.next() ? finding : null;
    }

    function rule(values) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord(RULE);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('company_field', 'company');
        gr.setValue('weight', 1);
        Object.keys(values).forEach(function (k) {
            gr.setValue(k, values[k]);
        });
        return gr;
    }

    describe('target state: OOTB asset/CI status mapping', function () {
        it('maps asset states to CI states and back', function () {
            const drift = new AssetCiDrift();
            expect(drift.expectedCiStatus('1', '')).toBe('1');
            expect(drift.expectedCiStatus('6', 'available')).toBe('6');
            expect(drift.expectedCiStatus('6', 'pending_repair')).toBe('5');
            expect(drift.expectedCiStatus('8', 'lost')).toBe('100');
            expect(drift.expectedAsset('5').substate).toBe('pending_repair');
            expect(drift.expectedAsset('7').state).toBe('7');
        });
    });

    describe('drift watcher', function () {
        it('finds drift and fixes it with the asset leading', function () {
            const company = newCompany('Drift A');
            const pair = newPair('DA1', company);
            newPair('DA2', company);
            forceCiStatus(pair.ci, '6');

            const scan = new AssetCiDrift().scan(company);
            expect(scan.success).toBe(true);
            expect(scan.data.population).toBe(2);
            expect(scan.data.created).toBe(1);
            const finding = openFinding(pair.asset);
            expect(finding.getValue('ci_status')).toBe('6');
            expect(finding.getValue('expected_ci_status')).toBe('1');
            expect(finding.getValue('preview_asset_leads')).toContain('In Stock');
            expect(finding.getValue('preview_ci_leads')).toContain('Available');

            const fix = new AssetCiDrift().fix(finding.getUniqueValue(), 'asset');
            expect(fix.success).toBe(true);
            expect(fix.status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(load('cmdb_ci', pair.ci).getValue('install_status')).toBe('1');
            const fixed = load(FINDING, finding.getUniqueValue());
            expect(fixed.getValue('state')).toBe('fixed');
            expect(fixed.getValue('leading_side')).toBe('asset');

            const audit = new GlideRecord(ItamKitConfig.table('audit_log'));
            audit.addQuery('finding', finding.getUniqueValue());
            audit.addQuery('field', 'install_status');
            audit.query();
            expect(audit.next()).toBe(true);
            expect(audit.getValue('old_value')).toBe('6');
            expect(audit.getValue('new_value')).toBe('1');

            expect(new AssetCiDrift().scan(company).data.drifting).toBe(0);
        });

        it('fixes drift with the CI leading', function () {
            const company = newCompany('Drift B');
            const pair = newPair('DB1', company);
            forceCiStatus(pair.ci, '7');
            new AssetCiDrift().scan(company);
            const finding = openFinding(pair.asset);
            const fix = new AssetCiDrift().fix(finding.getUniqueValue(), 'ci');
            expect(fix.success).toBe(true);
            expect(load('alm_hardware', pair.asset).getValue('install_status')).toBe('7');
            expect(new AssetCiDrift().count(company).data.defects).toBe(0);
        });

        it('validates the input and is idempotent', function () {
            const company = newCompany('Drift C');
            const pair = newPair('DC1', company);
            forceCiStatus(pair.ci, '6');
            new AssetCiDrift().scan(company);
            const findingId = openFinding(pair.asset).getUniqueValue();
            expect(new AssetCiDrift().fix(findingId, 'sideways').status_code).toBe(400);
            expect(new AssetCiDrift().fix('0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef', 'asset').status_code).toBe(404);
            expect(new AssetCiDrift().fix(findingId, 'asset').status_code).toBe(200);
            expect(new AssetCiDrift().fix(findingId, 'asset').status_code).toBe(208);
        });
    });

    describe('DQ scorecard', function () {
        it('evaluates the four rule types and rejects invalid rules', function () {
            const company = newCompany('Score');
            const maker = insert('core_company', {name: 'ATF Maker ' + stamp, manufacturer: true});
            const other = insert('core_company', {name: 'ATF Other ' + stamp, manufacturer: true});
            const model = insert('cmdb_hardware_product_model', {name: 'ATF Model ' + stamp, manufacturer: maker});
            newPair('S1', company, {serial_number: 'ATF-SN-1', model_id: model, manufacturer: maker});
            newPair('S2', company, {serial_number: 'ATF-SN-1', model_id: model, manufacturer: other});
            newPair('S3', company, {serial_number: 'ATF-SN-3', model_id: model, manufacturer: maker});
            const lonely = newPair('S4', company, {model_id: model, manufacturer: maker});
            forceCiStatus(lonely.ci, '6');

            const dq = new DqScorecard();
            const missing = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'cmdb_ci_hardware', rule_type: 'query', defect_query: 'serial_numberISEMPTY'}), company);
            expect(missing.status).toBe('ok');
            expect(missing.population).toBe(4);
            expect(missing.defects).toBe(1);
            expect(missing.score).toBe(75);

            const duplicate = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'cmdb_ci_hardware', rule_type: 'duplicate', field: 'serial_number'}), company);
            expect(duplicate.defects).toBe(1);

            const mismatch = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'cmdb_ci_hardware', rule_type: 'field_mismatch',
                field: 'manufacturer', compare_field: 'model_id.manufacturer'}), company);
            expect(mismatch.defects).toBe(1);

            const drift = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'alm_hardware', rule_type: 'drift'}), company);
            expect(drift.population).toBe(4);
            expect(drift.defects).toBe(1);

            const typo = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'cmdb_ci_hardware', rule_type: 'query', defect_query: 'serial_numbr=X'}), company);
            expect(typo.status).toBe('invalid');
            expect(typo.message).toContain('serial_numbr');

            const empty = dq.evaluate(rule({table_name: 'cmdb_ci_hardware', rule_type: 'query', population_query: 'install_status=8',
                defect_query: 'serial_numberISEMPTY'}), company);
            expect(empty.status).toBe('empty');
        });

        it('stores a snapshot whose score is the weighted mean of the rule scores', function () {
            const company = newCompany('Snapshot');
            newPair('P1', company, {serial_number: 'ATF-P-1'});
            newPair('P2', company);
            const card = insert(ItamKitConfig.table('dq_scorecard'), {name: 'ATF ' + stamp, company: company, active: true});
            const run = new DqScorecard().run(card, 'manual');
            expect(run.success).toBe(true);
            expect(run.status_code).toBe(201);

            let weighted = 0;
            let weights = 0;
            run.data.rules.forEach(function (r) {
                if (r.status !== 'ok') return;
                weighted += r.weight * (100 * (1 - r.defects / r.population));
                weights += r.weight;
            });
            expect(run.data.score).toBe(Math.round(100 * weighted / weights) / 100);
            const snapshot = load(ItamKitConfig.table('dq_snapshot'), run.data.snapshot_id);
            expect(parseFloat(snapshot.getValue('score'))).toBe(run.data.score);

            const latest = new DqScorecard().latest(card);
            expect(latest.data.results.length).toBe(run.data.rules.length);
        });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

jasmine.getEnv().execute();
</value><variable display_value="Test script">989d9e235324220002c6435723dc3484</variable></sys_variable_value></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_371499_itamkit_leaver_case</collection><condition/><description>Module 1: one asset_task per hardware asset still assigned to the leaver</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>ITAM Toolkit: create return tasks</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business rule «ITAM Toolkit: create return tasks» on <scope>_leaver_case, after insert.
 * Creates one asset_task per hardware asset still assigned to the leaver.
 * Idempotent: LeaverAssetResolver.resolve() calls syncTasks() again and gets 208.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    const result = new LeaverAssetResolver().syncTasks(current);
    if (!result.success) {
        gs.addErrorMessage(result.message);
    } else if (gs.getSession().isInteractive()) {
        gs.addInfoMessage(current.getValue('number') + ': ' + result.data.tasks_total + ' return task(s) for the leaver\'s hardware.');
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:39</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>c903e7acc3ac171015b012d4e40131e4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM Toolkit: create return tasks</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_c903e7acc3ac171015b012d4e40131e4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:39</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=c903e7acc3ac171015b012d4e40131e4"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_2df22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131ca
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitQuery</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Validates encoded queries; ServiceNow would silently drop unknown fields</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitQuery</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitQuery: checks encoded queries before the toolkit relies on them.
 *
 * ServiceNow silently drops query terms with an unknown field: a typo in
 * "assigned_to.actve=false" turns a filter into "all records". Every configurable
 * query of the toolkit (DQ rules, the leaver asset filter) goes through
 * unknownFields() first and is rejected with status 422 instead.
 */
var ItamKitQuery = Class.create();

// Longest operators first, so "NOT IN" wins over "IN" and "!=" over "=".
ItamKitQuery.OPERATOR = /^([a-z0-9_.]+?)(ISNOTEMPTY|ISEMPTY|ANYTHING|EMPTYSTRING|NOT IN|NOT LIKE|NOTLIKE|NSAMEAS|SAMEAS|STARTSWITH|ENDSWITH|DATEPART|RELATIVEGT|RELATIVELT|RELATIVEGE|RELATIVELE|BETWEEN|NOTON|ON|LIKE|IN|!=|>=|<=|=|>|<)/;

/** Splits an encoded query into its terms (AND and OR terms alike). */
ItamKitQuery.terms = function (query) {
    if (!query) return [];
    return String(query).split(/\^OR|\^NQ|\^/).filter(function (t) {
        return t && t !== 'EQ' && t.indexOf('ORDERBY') !== 0;
    });
};

/** True if the field path (dot-walk allowed) exists, starting at the given table. */
ItamKitQuery.isValidPath = function (table, path) {
    let gr = new GlideRecord(table);
    if (!gr.isValid()) return false;
    const parts = path.split('.');
    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (!gr.isValidField(parts[i])) return false;
        if (i === parts.length - 1) return true;
        const element = gr.getElement(parts[i]);
        const refTable = element.getReferenceTable ? element.getReferenceTable() : '';
        if (!refTable) return false;
        gr = new GlideRecord(refTable);
        if (!gr.isValid()) return false;
    }
    return true;
};

/**
 * Returns the problems of an encoded query on a table (empty array = valid):
 * unknown fields, terms without a recognised operator, and ^NQ (not supported,
 * because the toolkit combines queries with ^).
 */
ItamKitQuery.problems = function (table, query) {
    const problems = [];
    if (!query) return problems;
    if (String(query).indexOf('^NQ') >= 0) problems.push('^NQ is not supported');
    ItamKitQuery.terms(query).forEach(function (term) {
        const match = term.match(ItamKitQuery.OPERATOR);
        if (!match) {
            problems.push('no operator in "' + term + '"');
        } else if (!ItamKitQuery.isValidPath(table, match[1])) {
            problems.push('unknown field "' + match[1] + '" on ' + table);
        }
    });
    return problems;
};

/** Joins encoded queries with AND, skipping empty parts. */
ItamKitQuery.and = function () {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).filter(function (q) {
        return q;
    }).join('^');
};

ItamKitQuery.prototype = {
    type: 'ItamKitQuery'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 11:43:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>2df22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131ca</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ItamKitQuery</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ITAM Toolkit" source="x_371499_itamkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ITAM Toolkit">fd6e5324c3ac171015b012d4e4013128</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2df22facc3ac171015b012d4e40131ca</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 11:43:24</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_99f22facc3ac171015b012d4e401319e
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_371499_itamkit.ItamKitConfig</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Names of tables, properties, events and roles, derived from the running scope</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamKitConfig</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * ItamKitConfig: names of the toolkit's tables, properties and events.
 *
 * The scope name contains the instance's vendor prefix (x_<prefix>_itamkit). The
 * scripts never hard-code it: every name is derived from the running scope, so the
 * sources stay identical on every instance.
 */
var ItamKitConfig = Class.create();

ItamKitConfig.scope = function () {
    return gs.getCurrentScopeName();
};

/** ItamKitConfig.table('leaver_case') -> 'x_<prefix>_itamkit_leaver_case' */
ItamKitConfig.table = function (suffix) {
    return ItamKitConfig.scope() + '_' + suffix;
};

/** Column the toolkit adds to the global table asset_task */
ItamKitConfig.outcomeField = function () {
    return ItamKitConfig.scope() + '_return_outcome';
};

ItamKitConfig.prop = function (name, fallback) {
    return gs.getProperty(ItamKitConfig.scope() + '.' + name, fallback);
};

ItamKitConfig.event = function (name) {
    return ItamKitConfig.scope() + '.' + name;
};

ItamKitConfig.role = function (suffix) {
    return ItamKitConfig.scope() + '.' + suffix;
};

/** GlideElement booleans are objects (always truthy); compare their string value. */
ItamKitConfig.isTrue = function (element) {
    const value = String(element);
    return value === 'true' || value === '1';
};

ItamKitConfig.prototype = {
    type: 'ItamKitConfig'
};

sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_871367ecc3ac171015b012d4e40131c2
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>leaver resolve</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * POST /leaver/resolve  body {user: sys_id or user_name, last_working_day: 'yyyy-MM-dd'}:
 * opens the leaver case for an HR system integration; role admin.
 */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    ItamKitRest.handle(request, response, 'admin', function () {
        const body = request.body.data || {};
        const user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (!body.user || !(user.get(body.user) || user.get('user_name', body.user))) {
            return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'Body needs "user" (sys_id or user_name) of an existing user');
        }
        if (body.last_working_day && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(body.last_working_day)) {
            return ItamKitResult.fail(400, 'last_working_day must be yyyy-MM-dd');
        }
        return new LeaverAssetResolver().resolve(user.getUniqueValue(), 'manual', {lastWorkingDay: body.last_working_day});
